title: security: rbac-v2 enforce KMS region pinning with audit logging and residency checks
author: Aisha Malik
description: Context: Customers operating in regulated environments require guaranteed crypto key residency and auditable policy enforcement when using customer-managed KMS keys. This PR hardens RBAC v2 to enforce KMS region pinning, ties enforcement to audit logging, and adds residency checks to prevent cross-region key usage. Motivation: previous audit-only flag allowed policy drift and relied on downstream reviewers; we need enforcement for protected tenants and a clear migration path. What this change does: 1) Introduces a KMS residency enforcement layer that runs during authorization and key material resolution. 2) Adds an explicit rejection path when a request attempts to use a KMS key outside the allowed region(s) for the requesting tenant/account unless a special override role is present. 3) Emits structured audit events for policy evaluations, enforcement decisions, and fallback actions. 4) Adds configuration knobs for gradual rollout: policy.mode = audit|enforce, rollout.allowed_tenants whitelist, and an emergency-kill switch for fast rollback. 5) Adds comprehensive unit and integration tests and a migration guide. Backwards compatibility: default mode remains "audit" so no immediate breaking changes to existing tenants; toggling to "enforce" will cause authorization failures for misconfigured tenants. Rollout plan: feature gated behind org-level entitlement, start with a 2-week audit window for selected tenants (ENG-2148), then enable enforcement for orgs with clean audits. Checklist: - [x] Implement residency enforcement logic in rbac service - [x] Add audit log events with structured payloads - [x] Add config flags and feature gating - [x] Unit tests for enforcement and audit payloads - [x] Integration tests against KMS mock and residency fixtures - [x] Add migration and runbook docs - [x] Add monitoring/alerts on enforcement failures and rate of hits - [x] Security review and SRE runbook review Related: ENG-2148 (residency rollout), SUP-7123 (customer support request to block cross-region key usage). Links: design doc https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2148/kms-residency-and-rbac-v2-enforcement, internal runbook https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-region-pinning. Testing notes: initial CI run showed a flaky integration test (kms/fake_auth_test) failing intermittently; test was stabilized by ensuring deterministic clock and retry backoff and rerun in CI which then passed. No user-facing API changes. Migration notes: operators should run the provided audit tool to enumerate violations before flipping to enforce; migration guide is added under docs/security/kms-residency.md.
